text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wah... Your skin is breaking out so 
badly...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's why everyone kept asking, 
'Are you tired, Committee Chair Top 
Road?'...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I made everyone worry about me... I have 
to get better quickly!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Ugh, but still, I'm worried. I wonder 
if Trainer will notice it too...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Staring into the mirror, Narita Top Road 
fretted over a skin breakout...
